home.schemesHeading: Government Schemes We Match For You
home.schemesSubtitle: Our intelligent engine continuously aligns your enterprise profile with affirmative funding rules from premier ministries.
home.howHeading: How AI Funding & Scheme Matcher Bridges the Funding Gap
home.howSubtitle: Designed specifically for grassroots entrepreneurs who deserve affirmative government support.
home.how1Desc: Enter your business stage, social category (SC/ST/OBC/MBC/OC), location, and funding history in 3 simple steps.
home.how2Desc: Enterprise credentials and profiles are securely stored with PostgreSQL Row Level Security. Passwords and identity documents are never leaked.
home.how3Desc: Our Python FastAPI backend verifies cryptographic Bearer tokens, guaranteeing that every entrepreneur's data remains private and tamper-proof.
home.how4Desc: Instantly view matched subsidies, quota allocations, and preparation checklists ready for Phase 2 Gemini AI advisory.
home.securityHeading: Zero Aadhaar Collection & Absolute Data Sovereignty
home.securityDesc: In strict adherence to regulatory privacy standards, AI Funding & Scheme Matcher never asks for, collects, or stores Aadhaar numbers or physical document scans. All demographic fields are used solely for affirmative benefit computation under the user's explicit consent.
home.footerDesc: An affirmative entrepreneurship platform engineered for Smart India Hackathon. Bridging central and state funding opportunities to marginalized innovators across India.

dashboard.heading: Entrepreneur Scheme Dashboard
dashboard.subheading: Your verified funding opportunities and affirmative match evaluation
dashboard.matchingCardDesc: Deterministic, explainable profile matching against verified central and state schemes.
dashboard.complianceAdvisory: Official Compliance Advisory: Match scores are profile-fit indicators based on available data, not official eligibility probabilities or funding guarantees. Missing profile information is never treated as proof of eligibility. If a criterion is unverified or unknown, it is strictly flagged as “Needs verification”. Always confirm specific guidelines and cohort deadlines on official portals before applying.
dashboard.searchPlaceholder: Search by scheme name, provider department, or benefits...
dashboard.notEligible: Not eligible based on a verified rule
dashboard.noSchemesDesc: No government schemes met the exact filter combination. Try clearing your search query or loosening filter constraints.

roadmap.title: Scheme Application Roadmap

roadmap.disclaimerText: This gap analysis compares your saved profile attributes against published official rules for guidance only. It does not constitute government approval or guarantee funding sanction. Never alter personal background, demographic category, or identity data to force eligibility.
